title: 第11章 杨康10第12章 杨康11
content_zh:
于是江湖上瞬间多了很多流言，真真假假让人分辨不清！
“全真教可是在大金的地盘上，王重阳真人绝对是大金忠臣！不然怎么不在大宋开教立派呢！”
“怎么可能！听说丘处机道长这么多年一直在抗金，还杀了很多金人呢！”
“他们一边收着我们的香火供奉，却杀着我们的亲朋好友，这不是通敌卖国吗？不行，我要去举报他们！”
“听说朝廷要整治他们了呢！你说丘处机道长会怎么做啊！”
“不过全真教到底是心向大宋还是大金啊！你说我们要不要去看看？”
“丘处机道长还骂大金皇帝认贼作父，是畜生呢！”
.......
就在流言满天的时候，其他江湖人士自然听说了这些传言，本身以为是宵小之徒作祟，但听多了以后心里面不免有些想法。
首先，全真教如果真的心向大宋，为什么把教派建立在金朝，这不符合常理啊；丘处机杀了那么多金人，全真教却享受着金人百姓的香火，这属实有点不要脸了；至于江湖人士虽然不惧朝廷，但也不会轻易对上啊！毕竟大家对自己的能力都有认知，一个人如果能顶的上千军万马，那这人简直是成神了！王重阳当日尚且不敢如此呢！
江湖传言自然是真真假假，其实全真教倒是没有建立在金朝，王重阳建立的时候还是属于大宋，算交界处，当时两国也在交战中，所以终南山也算是抗金前线，这也能看出来王重阳的志向。只不过大宋不争气啊！
王重阳建立没多久，宋金两国开战，主和派占据上风的大宋自然不会主动招惹金国，能用钱买和平当然是好，至于已经被占领的地方也无所谓了！这就是北人归北，南人归南了！
王重阳早逝未必没有对宋金时局的悲哀！
但那又如何，终南山最终变成了金国的地盘，这就给人一种错觉，王重阳把全真教建在了大金的地盘上，这不就给了杨康操作的空间吗？
杨康喊的旗号很明显，那就是丘处机杀人行凶，辱骂皇帝，要求全真教将他交出来！
杀人诛心，杨康还是想看看丘处机得知自己给全真教带来灭顶之灾的样子！
毕竟丘处机一向自诩名门正派，做事只顾自己，从来不考虑后果，牛家村之事不就是因他而起吗？他要做的就是杀鸡儆猴，毕竟江湖人士高高在上太久了，根本看不到自己给别人带来的苦难！
远的不说，洪七公在皇宫大内偷吃，那些厨子因他受罚丢命的可不少，郭靖黄蓉在大街上和欧阳克手下交手，周围的摊贩又被损伤多少，他们谁又补偿过！就是自诩侠义为先的洪七公都没有，更何况是其他人了！
现在借着丘处机开刀，也是给他们一个警告！说到底还是没人管理这些江湖人士才让他们如此，想到这，杨康不免有些头疼！
不过现在最重要的还是丘处机这只鸡怎么杀才能让其他人有敬畏之心!

至于丘处机能不能被抓，杨康完全不担心。
毕竟全真教即便再厉害，也敌不过大军压境！否则当日王重阳就不会当道士，而是凭借一己之力让大金灭国了！
全真教众人自然也知道了这些传言，但他们已经无暇顾及了！
全真七子剩下的几个人没想到大金的速度这么快，根本没有给他们反应的时间，本身以为杨康只是说一说，但没想到他真的派大军围山了，并令他们十日内交出丘处机，不然全真教上下按包庇罪论处，一个不留！
先不说丘处机本身不在全真教，就是在他们也不可能交出去啊！
他们七人感情一向很好，自然不会出卖兄弟！但问题是大军围山，他们不可能不吃不喝啊！而且下面的小弟子们心性不行，听到江湖传言本身就议论纷纷，现在更是人心不稳！
每个门派都有自己的生存之道，丐帮还有污衣和净衣之分呢！说到底每个门派的明争暗斗都不少，只是看怎么平衡罢了！全真教三代首徒迟迟没有定下来，下面的小弟子更是拉帮结派，恨不得能借此消灭几个对手！
他们平日里对此倒是没怎么管，但现在不行啊！现在如果不能一致对外，全真教该怎么办？
最近几天他们没少听见有人在私下抱怨丘处机，说他自己在外面逍遥，不管全真教死活！
虽然他们可以让人不开口议论，但他们管得了人，管不了心啊！
他们倒是可以用雷霆手段阻止，但这样一来，这怕军队还没有来，他们全真教内部就土崩瓦解了！
掌教马钰简直是头大！
师傅临终前将全真教交付给他，他也一直兢兢业业，希望能实现师傅昔日的梦想，但他没想到全真教没被自己发扬光大，反而到了生死存亡的地步！丘处机他不能交出去
，全真教他又不能不顾及，简直是进退两难！
其他几人当然也清楚马钰的心思，但他们也没有办法啊！只能一日日的拖着，但心里却不免有些埋怨丘处机平日处事太过高调张扬，不然何至于此！其他江湖人杀金人也不是没有，但人家怎么就没有祸及门派呢！
其实丘处机倒也没不管全真教，只是大金的军队速度太快，等他得到消息往回赶，已经来不及了！
江湖上的传言已经止不住了，甚至丘处机感觉自己走到哪都有人在看自己。
这倒不是丘处机的错觉，毕竟全真教一事最近可是沸沸扬扬，你要是不知道，那就是孤陋寡闻了！
八卦心每个人都有，大家是真的很想知道丘处机和全真教的选择是什么！
毕竟自从华山论剑王重阳夺得天下第一之后，全真教就压在了其他门派之上，甚至是全真弟子平日里都一副高高在上的样子，这早就让很多人不满。

而且全真教平日里打着抗金的名义做了多少事情，现在被人家找上门来，那也是咎由自取！别说他们没那么大的胸怀，就是有，也不是谁都能压上整个门派去帮全真教的，就是丐帮都不可能！
现在既然有机会看热闹，这些人当然不会放过！他们虽然和全真教没什么太大的仇怨，但也没什么交集，不落井下石都不错了！
可以说现在整个江湖的都在看全真教会怎么选择！
content_en:
As a result, a lot of rumors suddenly appeared in the world, and it was hard to tell whether they were true or false!
"The Quanzhen Sect is on the territory of the Jin Dynasty, and Wang Chongyang is definitely a loyal minister of the Jin Dynasty! Otherwise, why didn't he establish a sect in the Song Dynasty?"
"How is that possible! I heard that Taoist Master Qiu Chuji has been resisting the Jin for so many years and has killed many Jin people!"
"They accept our incense offerings while killing our relatives and friends. Isn't this treason and treason? No, I'm going to report them!"
"I heard that the imperial court is going to punish them! What do you think Taoist Master Qiu Chuji will do!"
"But does the Quanzhen Sect prefer the Song Dynasty or the Jin Dynasty? Do you think we should go and have a look?"
"Taoist Master Qiu Chuji also scolded Emperor Dajin for recognizing a thief as his father. He is a beast!"
.......
When the rumors were all over the sky, other people in the world naturally heard about these rumors. They thought it was a young person who was responsible, but after hearing too much, they couldn't help but have some thoughts in their hearts.
First of all, if the Quanzhen Sect really loves the Song Dynasty, why did it establish the sect in the Jin Dynasty? This is not in line with common sense; Qiu Chuji killed so many Jin people, but the Quanzhen Sect enjoys the incense of the Jin people. After all, everyone is aware of their own abilities. If a person can withstand thousands of troops, then this person will become a god! Wang Chongyang didn't dare to do this that day!
The rumors in the world are naturally true and false. In fact, the Quanzhen Sect was not established in the Jin Dynasty. When Wang Chongyang established it, it still belonged to the Song Dynasty. It was considered the junction of the two countries. At that time, the two countries were also at war, so Zhongnan Mountain was also regarded as the front line against the Jin Dynasty. This can also show Wang Chongyang's ambition. It’s just that the Song Dynasty failed to live up to expectations!
Not long after Wang Chongyang was established, the Song Dynasty and Jin Dynasty went to war. The Song Dynasty, where the peace faction had the upper hand, naturally would not take the initiative to provoke the Jin Kingdom. It was of course good to be able to buy peace with money. As for the places that had already been occupied, it didn't matter! This is when people from the north return to the north and people from the south return to the south!
Wang Chongyang's early death may not be without sadness for the current situation of the Song and Jin Dynasties!
But so what, Zhongnan Mountain eventually became the territory of the Jin Kingdom, which gave people the illusion that Wang Chongyang built the Quanzhen Sect on the territory of the Jin Kingdom. Didn't this give Yang Kang room to operate?
The banner shouted by Yang Kang was very obvious, that is, Qiu Chuji committed murder, insulted the emperor, and demanded that the Quanzhen Religion hand him over!
Even though he wanted to kill someone, Yang Kang still wanted to see Qiu Chuji when he learned that he had brought disaster to the Quanzhen Sect!
After all, Qiu Chuji has always prided himself on being a well-known and upright person who only cares about himself when doing things and never considers the consequences. Didn't the incident in Niujiacun happen because of him? What he has to do is kill the chicken and scare the monkey. After all, people in the world have been aloof for too long and cannot see the suffering they have brought to others!
Not to mention, Hong Qigong was eating secretly in the palace. Many cooks were punished and died because of him. Guo Jing and Huang Rong fought with Ouyang Ke's men on the street. How much damage was done to the surrounding vendors, and none of them made compensation! Not even Hong Qigong, who claims to be chivalrous first, let alone others!
Now using Qiu Chuji to operate is also a warning to them! After all, it was because no one managed these people that they were like this. Thinking of this, Yang Kang couldn't help but have a headache!
But the most important thing now is how to kill Qiu Chuji’s chicken so that others will be in awe!
As for whether Qiu Chuji could be caught, Yang Kang was not worried at all.
After all, no matter how powerful the Quanzhen Sect is, it can't defeat the overwhelming army! Otherwise, Wang Chongyang would not have been a Taoist priest that day, but would have allowed Dai Jin to destroy the country by himself!
Everyone in the Quanzhen Sect naturally knew about these rumors, but they had no time to take them into consideration!
The remaining Seven Sons of Quanzhen did not expect that Da Jin was so fast and did not give them any time to react. They thought that Yang Kang was just talking, but they did not expect that he actually sent a large army to surround the mountain and ordered them toHand over Qiu Chuji within ten days, otherwise the Quanzhen Sect will be punished as a cover-up and no one will be left alive!
Not to mention that Qiu Chuji himself was not in the Quanzhen Sect, even if he was in the Quanzhen Sect, he would not be able to hand it over!
The seven of them have always had a good relationship, so naturally they would not betray their brothers! But the problem is that the army is surrounding the mountain, and it is impossible for them not to eat or drink! Moreover, the young disciples below are not of good character. They started talking a lot when they heard the rumors in the world, and now their hearts are even more unstable!
Each sect has its own way of survival, and the Beggar Clan is divided into dirty clothes and clean clothes! After all, every sect has a lot of overt and covert struggles, it just depends on how to balance it! The third generation leader of the Quanzhen Sect has not yet been decided, and the younger disciples below are forming cliques, hoping to eliminate several opponents!
They usually don't care much about this, but not now! Now if the Quanzhen Religion cannot be unanimous in communicating with the outside world, what should the Quanzhen Sect do?
In recent days, they had often heard people complaining privately about Qiu Chuji, saying that he was enjoying himself outside and did not care whether the Quanzhen Cult was alive or dead!
Although they can make people stop talking, they can control people but not their hearts!
They could use thunderous means to stop it, but in this case, the Quanzhen Sect would fall apart before the army came!
The head coach Ma Yu is simply a big head!
The master handed over the Quanzhen Religion to him before his death, and he has been working hard, hoping to realize his master's dream in the past. However, he did not expect that the Quanzhen Religion was not promoted by him, but was in danger of life and death! He can't hand over Qiu Chuji
, Quanzhen taught him but he had to take it into consideration, it was a dilemma!
Of course the other people knew what Ma Yu was thinking, but they had nothing to do! I could only drag it on day by day, but in my heart I couldn't help but complain that Qiu Chuji was too high-profile in his daily work, otherwise why would he be like this! It's true that other Jianghu people killed the golden man, but why didn't they bring harm to the sect?
In fact, Qiu Chuji didn't ignore the Quanzhen Sect, but Dajin's army was too fast. By the time he got the news and rushed back, it was already too late!
The rumors in the world couldn't stop, and Qiu Chuji even felt like people were watching him wherever he went.
This is not Qiu Chuji's illusion. After all, the Quanzhen Sect has been a hot topic recently. If you don't know, then you are ignorant!
Everyone has the heart of Bagua, and everyone really wants to know what the choice between Qiu Chuji and the Quanzhen Sect will be!
After all, ever since Huashan Sword Master Chongyang won the first place in the world, the Quanzhen Sect has been on top of other sects. Even Quanzhen disciples usually act aloof, which has long made many people dissatisfied.
Moreover, the Quanzhen Sect has done so many things in the name of fighting against gold, and now that someone is coming to visit them, it is their own fault! Not to mention that they don’t have such a big mind, even if they do, not everyone can pressure the entire sect to help the Quanzhen Sect, not even the Beggar Clan!
Now that they have the opportunity to watch the excitement, of course these people will not let it go! Although they don't have much enmity with the Quanzhen Sect, they don't have much in common, so it's good if they don't add insult to injury!
It can be said that the entire world is now watching how the Quanzhen Church chooses!
